raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  build_number: 11
  name: ocaml-dune
  version: "3.24.2"

  # ocaml_win-64 ships gcc_* and vs2022_* at the same version/build; name the track.
  c_toolchain: ${{ "" if unix else c_compiler ~ "_*" }}
  library: ${{ "Library/" if not unix else "" }}
  m2: ${{ "m2-" if not unix else "" }}
  sh: ${{ "sh" if unix else "bat" }}

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/ocaml/dune/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 3c4facfef1bc1f96235808865665b94857e6e508ce346bfc36b53b775fd8423c
    patches:
      - patches/0001-blake3-disable-neon-when-architecture-is-not-arm64.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ c_compiler ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  script:
    file: build.sh
  dynamic_linking:
    missing_dso_allowlist:
      - if: not unix
        then:
          - C:/Windows/system32/SHLWAPI.dll
          - C:/Windows/system32/VERSION.dll

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("ocaml") }}
    - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
      else:
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    - ${{ m2 }}bash >=5.2
    - ${{ m2 }}make
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
        # self-activating cross tree with ocaml_use_native/ocaml_use_cross
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }}[version="${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*", build_number=">=18"]
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* gcc_*
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - ocaml-dune
    - if: unix
      then:
        - file
      else:
        - ${{ m2 }}coreutils
  host:
    - if: target_platform != "linux-s390x"
      then:
        - zstd
  run_constraints:
    - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} >=${{ ocaml_compiler_version }} ${{ c_toolchain }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      - zstd

tests:
  # Package contents validation
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - dune
      files:
        - ${{ library }}doc/dune/CHANGES.md
        - ${{ library }}doc/dune/LICENSE.md
        - ${{ library }}doc/dune/README.md
        - ${{ library }}doc/dune/odoc-pages/index.mld
        - ${{ library }}lib/dune/META
        - ${{ library }}lib/dune/dune-package
        - ${{ library }}lib/dune/opam
        - ${{ library }}share/man/man1/*
        - ${{ library }}share/man/man5/dune-config.5
        - ${{ library }}share/emacs/site-lisp/dune/dune-{flymake,watch}.el
        - ${{ library }}share/emacs/site-lisp/dune/dune.el
        - etc/conda/activate.d/dune-activate.${{ sh }}
        - etc/conda/deactivate.d/dune-deactivate.${{ sh }}
        # Tests artifacts
        - etc/conda/test-files/ocaml-dune/*

  # Python-based functional tests (all arm64 lanes are native)
  - script: |
      python testing/run_all_tests.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - testing/test_utils.py
        - testing/run_all_tests.py
        - testing/probe-dune-cache.py
        - testing/test-dune-activation.py
        - testing/test-dune-arch.py
        - testing/test-dune-build.py
        - testing/test-dune-cmi.py
        - testing/test-dune-config.py
        - testing/test-dune-stubs.py
        - testing/test-dune-version.py
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ m2 }}file
        - python >=3.9
      run:
        - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
        - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: A composable build system for OCaml.
  homepage: https://dune.build/
  repository: https://github.com/ocaml/dune

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
